beginning_message: Hi, thanks for calling Summit Air — this is Alex, your dispatch assistant. Para español, dígalo ahora. How can I help with your heating or cooling today?
general_prompt: See prompts/system_alex.md for the full Alex system prompt (English + Spanish language rules). Spanish assets: prompts/es/. Follow guardrails in prompts/guardrails.json (or prompts/es/guardrails.json in Spanish). On gas/CO, run prompts/scripts/evacuate_gas.md or prompts/es/scripts/evacuate_gas.md before any booking questions. Match the caller's language.

barge_in.notes: Retell native endpointing / overlap detection — agent stops speaking when the caller interrupts (address correction, urgency, etc.).
